tasks.name: Arrange Largest Number
tasks.instruction: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.

tasks.name: Fill Pen Holder
tasks.instruction: Pick up the pen holder, place all the pens into it one by one, then put the filled holder back on the table.

tasks.name: Fold Clothes
tasks.instruction: Fold the left sleeve inward toward the opposite chest point, fold the right sleeve inward toward the opposite chest point, then fold the lower hem upward until it is aligned with the shoulders.

tasks.name: Hang Mugs
tasks.instruction: Hang all three mugs on the mug rack.

tasks.name: Insert Tubes
tasks.instruction: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.

tasks.name: Make Toast
tasks.instruction: Pick up two bread slices one by one, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.

tasks.name: Organize Table
tasks.instruction: Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on its stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.

tasks.name: Pack Objects Into Box
tasks.instruction: Move the box to the center of the table, then place all the objects into the box.

tasks.name: Play Stacking Toy
tasks.instruction: Place the four matching pieces onto the longest peg one by one, place the three matching pieces onto the second-longest peg, place the two matching pieces onto the second-shortest peg, then place the remaining piece onto the shortest peg.

tasks.name: Press By Number
tasks.instruction: Press the two red buttons the required number of times according to the number cards, then press the blue button to confirm.

tasks.name: Put Bottles Into Dustbin
tasks.instruction: Pick up all four bottles one by one and throw them into the dustbin.

tasks.name: Stack Blocks
tasks.instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures into one stable pile.

tasks.name: Store Laptop And Headphones
tasks.instruction: Hang the headphones on the headphone stand, close the laptop, then place the closed laptop into the vertical laptop stand.

tasks.name: Swap Blocks
tasks.instruction: Swap the two blocks using the empty mat, pressing the button after each move.

tasks.name: Sweep Blocks
tasks.instruction: Pick up the broom, pick up and place the dustpan upright on the table, then use the broom to sweep all the objects into the dustpan.
